summary.text: Erika Askeland is the Democratic candidate for the Arkansas House of Representatives, District 32, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Jack Ladyman.
She won the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary over Joshua Alfano and was the Democratic candidate for Arkansas State Senate District 20 in 2024, losing to Republican Dan Sullivan.
